$schema: Screenshot manifest for ShiftControl documentation. Used by AI agents to recapture screenshots.
fallback: If a mode doesn't have a screenshot, fall back to jc-google. The ModeScreenshot component handles this automatically.
notes: IMPORTANT: Run dev:test-demo-screenshot (not dev:test-demo) to hide TanStack devtools logo.
Every product screenshot varies by mode — even subtle differences like dropdown arrows on Add buttons in dual-directory modes.
All screenshots are captured per mode × per theme (light + dark).
The 'modes' array on each screenshot controls which mode variants to capture.
Use the localUrl during development, baseUrl for production recaptures.
NAVIGATION: Use direct URLs, NOT clicking. AG Grid rows don't have standard <tr> elements — click navigation fails silently.
MODAL SUPPRESSION: The mode= param triggers a welcome modal. Suppress it BEFORE navigation with: page.addInitScript(() => localStorage.setItem('SC_DEMO_WELCOME_LAST_SHOWN', new Date().toISOString()))
TABS (Users): Use ?tab=security|appPermissions|saasCost URL param. Set mode/theme first, suppress modal, THEN navigate to tab URL.
TABS (Groups/Apps): No URL param support yet — must click Radix UI tabs after page load. Use position-based clicking or [role='tab'] selectors.
SIDEBAR TABS: Right sidebar tabs require clicking after page load. Use position-based x>900 disambiguation.
VERIFICATION: After each capture batch, run duplicate detection to catch navigation failures immediately.

knownIds._comment: Direct-navigable IDs from mock data. Use these in URLs instead of clicking AG Grid rows.
knownIds._note_sso: Use app_bamboohr_sso for SSO tab screenshots — it has actual SAML config. AWS doesn't always have SSO configured in the demo.

directUrls._comment: Use these URLs to navigate directly instead of clicking through the UI.

screenshots._comment: All paths relative to static/img/ShiftControl/. All captured per mode × per theme unless 'modes' restricts it.

Users/User-management.description: Users list — directory icons, status, group/app counts. In jc_gws mode, Add User has a dropdown arrow for Google user option.

Users/User-detail-info.description: User detail — profile fields, directory status icons in header. jc_gws shows Google Workspace section below standard fields.

Users/User-detail-google-section.action: Scroll down to Google Workspace section
Users/User-detail-google-section.description: Google Workspace fields: recovery email, recovery phone, directory toggle, email aliases

Users/User-detail-security.description: Security tab. jc_gws: Google 2SV + JumpCloud MFA side by side. jc_only: JumpCloud MFA only. gws_only: Google security only.

Users/User-detail-app-permissions.description: Active OAuth permissions and history. Tab only exists with Google connected. In jc_only this tab is replaced by SaaS Cost.

Users/User-detail-saas-cost.description: Per-user SaaS spend breakdown by app

Users/Add-a-user.action: Click 'Add User' button. In jc_gws mode, button has dropdown arrow with Google user option.
Users/Add-a-user.description: New user creation form — Details tab with identity and org fields

Users/User-sidebar-groups.description: User sidebar showing group memberships with assignment method icons (JC/Google/sync indicators vary by mode)

Users/User-sidebar-apps.description: User sidebar showing app access with group source

Groups/Group-management.description: Groups list — tags, directory icons, sync status, member counts. In jc_gws, Add Group has dropdown arrow for Google group option.

Groups/Group-detail.group: Use 'All Departments' for gws_only. Any group for others.
Groups/Group-detail.description: Group detail — membership rules, sidebar with users/apps/rules. Directory icons in header vary by mode.

Groups/Add-a-group.action: Click 'Add Group' button (has dropdown in jc_gws mode)

Groups/Edit-a-group-details.description: Group General tab — name, description, tag, Google Sync toggle

Groups/Group-sidebar-rules.description: Group sidebar — rule counts (Dynamic, Nested, Individual)

Groups/Group-sidebar-users.description: Group sidebar — member list with assignment method and directory icons

Apps/App-management.description: Installed apps list — type, spend, group/user counts

Apps/App-catalog.description: App catalog — search, 900+ apps with functionality badges

Apps/App-discovery.description: Shadow IT detection — discovered OAuth apps with activity counts

Apps/App-detail.description: App detail — General tab with ownership, sidebar. SSO tab varies by app type.

Apps/Edit-app-general-info.description: App General tab — name, admin, budget owner, department, description

Apps/Edit-app-sso.app: BambooHR (0191dac9-e6a4-7d6d-97c4-229ea0c61592) — has actual SAML SSO config. Do NOT use AWS or non-SSO apps.
Apps/Edit-app-sso.description: SSO configuration — IdP certificate, metadata, SAML settings. Tab only exists with JumpCloud connected.

Apps/App-sidebar-groups.description: App sidebar — assigned groups with directory icons

Apps/App-sidebar-users.description: App sidebar — users with access and directory icons

Dashboards/Dashboard-overview.description: OAuth permissions dashboard — metrics, trend chart, app list, user grants

Dashboards/App-spend-dashboard.description: SaaS spend dashboard — costs by department, renewals, top spend

Reports/App-assignment-reports.description: App assignment report — pivot by app or user, expandable rows

Settings/Directories.description: Directory connectors — IdPs and HRIS with status, health, primary indicator. Row composition varies per mode.

Settings/Google-admins.description: Google Workspace admin accounts with roles and scope

Settings/JumpCloud-admins.description: JumpCloud admin accounts with MFA status and API access

Settings/Org-details.description: Organization name, domain, currency, feature toggles

Settings/Account-settings.description: Personal profile — name, email, security methods

Settings/Settings-account-settings.description: Account settings — profile and security methods (detail view)

Settings/Settings-org-details.description: Org name, domain, currency, feature toggles

Command-bar.action: Press Cmd+K to open command bar overlay

Task-management.description: Task management list with pending tasks

DigitalCards/Card-template.description: Digital cards designer, Template sub-tab. Tab state is component-local — click the tab, there is no URL param. Panel is identical across modes; only the settings sidebar differs.

DigitalCards/Card-fields.description: Digital cards designer, Fields sub-tab — per-field mode, sync toggles, and the employee self-service switches. Click the tab; there is no URL param.

DigitalCards/Card-offboarding.description: Digital cards designer, Offboarding sub-tab — Generic card / Redirect / Hard 404 plus the grace-period stepper. Click the tab; there is no URL param.

DigitalCards/Card-domain.description: Digital cards designer, Domain sub-tab — the always-on ShiftControl hostname and the custom-domain form. Click the tab; there is no URL param.

DigitalCards/User-card-panel.description: Digital card tab on a user record (admin-on-behalf). Sub-tabs are Edit card / QR code / Manage — no My card tab on this surface. Demo mock renders a different person on the card than in the record header, so keep alt text generic.

EmployeePortal/My-card.description: Employee portal My card tab — live card, QR, copy link, and QR download sizes. Sidebar label is 'My digital card'. Click the tab; there is no URL param.

EmployeePortal/My-card-edit.description: Employee portal Edit my card tab — photo controls and card details with locked / synced / customized field states.

EmployeePortal/My-card-qr.description: Employee portal My QR code tab — centre medallion picker (Company logo / None / My photo / Custom image).

EmployeePortal/My-card-manage.description: Employee portal Manage tab — card status with publish/unpublish and the card PIN. Link regeneration only appears when the org allows it.

Devices/Device-bulk-unmanage.action: Select 2+ device rows, then open the Bulk Actions toolbar button (4th icon after the search box). AG Grid checkboxes are NOT in the accessibility tree — click them by coordinate. The trigger is disabled below 2 selected rows. Close the Columns panel if a stray click opened it.
Devices/Device-bulk-unmanage.description: Device Inventory with devices selected and the Bulk Actions menu open on Un-manage. Requires JumpCloud, so no gws_only variant.

Users/User-avatar-upload.action: Cropped region around the record-header avatar. The pencil badge is visible without hovering. Note interceptor --region coordinates are in 2x CSS space, not CSS pixels.
Users/User-avatar-upload.description: Avatar edit affordance that writes a user's Google Workspace profile photo. Requires a Google directory, so no jc_only variant.
